ability.hint: An ability that an actor can use. These cannot go on actors directly and must be embedded in some item.

attunement.hint: A tracker representing attunement with some item or effect.

base.hint: A generic effect that doesn't have any particular rules purpose.

condition.hint: A pre-defined static effect on an actor.

consequence.hint: An effect that lingers on an actor as the result of some ability.

cover.hint: The effect of being in some type of cover.

fluency.hint: A fluency in a particular tradecraft.

hack.hint: Rules text and automations describing a specific type of hack damage on an actor.

imbuement.hint: An effect that lingers on an armament as the result of some ability.

property.hint: An effect that defines additional rules for what an armament does or how it's used.

resource.hint: An abstract counter representing something that needs tracking.

creature.hint: Actors best suited for monsters and reusable baddies.

environment.hint: An actor representing a hazard, terrain, trap, or other feature of the surroundings rather than some being.

inventory.hint: An actor representing a bag, chest, or shared storage rather than some being.

npc.hint: A named actor with specific stats and abilities controlled by the GM.

pc.hint: A named actor with specific stats and abilities controlled by a player.

adeptitude.hint: Make the actor adept at something.

binding.hint: Make the actor bound to something.

hexproof.hint: Make the actor hexproof to something.

immunity.hint: Make the actor immune to something.

incapability.hint: Makes the actor incapable of something.

ineptitude.hint: Makes the actor inept at something.

resistance.hint: Make the actor resistant to something.

takeBoost.hint: Make the actor take boosted from something.

takeDeboost.hint: Make the actor take deboosted from something.

vulnerability.hint: Make the actor vulnerable to something.

addDocuments.hint: Add items and effects to target actor or item.

attunement.hint: Add custom attunement to an actor.

changeCompetence.hint: Make an effect or item proficient or fluent.

changeMovement.hint: Switch tokens to a different movement action.

changeQuantity.hint: Change the quantity of a consumable item or effect.

changes.hint: Apply changes to parent actor or item.

childChange.hint: Apply changes to other effects and items on an actor.

choices.hint: Ask for a choice that can referenced by other automations.

duration.hint: Set the duration of this ability's effect.

move.hint: Move tokens toward or away from some point.

override.hint: Override default ability execution behavior and effect.

region.hint: Place a region in the scene.

roll.hint: Roll for damage, drain, or some other numeric command.

rollStyle.hint: Set the 3D dice style for rolls using this.

status.hint: Apply, remove, or toggle a condition.

summon.hint: Summon tokens representing some actor into the scene.

take.hint: Take damage, drain, or some other numeric command.

target.hint: Select targets within some area of effect.

toggleChildren.hint: Add or removes effects and items.

stone.hint: A stone from the death bag.

base.hint: A generic group that shares a turn.

commanded.hint: Minions that act on their commander's turn.

mob.hint: Mobs that share a turn, actions, and rolls.

status.hint: Expire based on the actor's conditions.

archetype.hint: An item containing abilities that a whole family of classes share.

body.hint: Armaments that are part of an actor's body.

equipment.hint: Armaments that exist independently of an actor.

mount.hint: An item representing the effects gained by riding on some other being.

power.hint: A generic item that contain a number of effects.

rank.hint: The abilities and other effects gained from a rank in a class.

species.hint: The collection of powers that a being gains from their species type.

damage.hint: Rules text and automations for a damage type.

drain.hint: Rules text and automations for a drain type.

rule.hint: Rules text for a core rule, condition, keyword, or similar entry.

style.hint: Rules text for a weapon fighting style.
